name: Credential Stuffing — Failure Followed by Successful Login
description: Uses EQL sequence detection to identify the moment of potential account compromise: multiple authentication failures from the same source IP and username, followed by a successful login within a 5-minute window. This targets the specific pattern where an attacker works through a stolen credential list and eventually succeeds. More targeted than pure volume-based rules — catches attacks that stay below the failure threshold.
query:
sequence by source.ip, user.name with maxspan=5m
  [ any where event.outcome == "failure" ]
  [ any where event.outcome == "success" ]
author: Noel Biju John
